abstract: The Tumor Immune Single Cell Hub (TISCH) is a curated resource for exploring single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data from the tumor microenvironment. Here, we present TISCH3, which expands the single-cell collection from 190 to 408 datasets and introduces 69 spatial transcriptomics datasets, bringing the total to 477 datasets. The 218 newly added scRNA-seq datasets span 48 cancer types, and the spatial collection spans 27 cancer types. Spatial samples are curated and processed individually, and single-cell references enable estimation of cell-type composition at each spot. The spatial workspace comprises six modules: Overview, GeneExp, spatially variable genes (SVGs), CellAssoc, Communication, and Downloads. These modules provide sample metadata and quality-control views, spatial gene expression maps, ranking of SVG, cell-type correlation and conditional intra-spot co-occurrence analyses, inferred cell-cell communication networks, and downloadable data and results. TISCH3 retains the single-cell analysis capabilities of TISCH2 and extends them to spatial exploration of the tumor microenvironment. The database is freely available without registration at https://tisch3.compbio.cn/.
